bosses.name: Gaia, the True Ground
bosses.intro_line: To stand on her is normal. To stand against her is a category error she will not notice making fatal.

phase_flavor.opening: priority: Become the World turn 1, then sit. She does nothing but exist and shrug. Teaches the player their Spike does nothing.
phase_flavor.pressure: priority: alternate Boulder Smash on the most-clustered enemies and Bulwark re-root. Punishes formation.
phase_flavor.desperation: priority: The Long Settling on whoever carries the Bane/Ouranos seam (root the answer), Boulder Smash everything else. She starts targeting the counter.
phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock, then Boulder Smash every turn at ramped entropy — now each blow is a landslide that can delete a creature. Become the World refreshes only if interrupted. Race condition: kill her before the clock turns her one move lethal.

bosses.name: Ouranos, the True Sky
bosses.intro_line: There is no going first against him. He is first.

phase_flavor.opening: priority: Tailwind first (stack the speed lead), establishing that he goes before everyone.
phase_flavor.pressure: priority: Gale Slash the lowest-HP enemy to fish for a kill that procs Outrun the Verdict (double turn). Tempo bully.
phase_flavor.desperation: priority: Before You Finish the Thought on the enemy's biggest threat each round, racing to thin the squad before they assemble lethal alpha.
phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock + signature every turn; at high entropy his first-strike alone deletes a creature per round. The player must already have the killing blow loaded — there is no "next turn" against him.

bosses.name: Cosmos, the True Order
bosses.intro_line: To break its rule you would first have to be the kind of thing its rule permits. You are not.

phase_flavor.opening: priority: As It Is Written turn 1; from now your crits read "0 — forbidden." Establishes the rule.
phase_flavor.pressure: priority: Bind the enemy's Chaos/Gambit carrier (silence the answer), Aegis to refresh. Targets the counter on purpose.
phase_flavor.desperation: priority: The Index Closes to disable the player's best skill, stalling for the entropy clock to make its trickle-damage Boulder-of-rules lethal.
phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock under the seal — entropy ramps its output while the player's stays capped; "order, accelerating." Only a Chaos burst that beats the ×1.5 wall ends it.

bosses.name: Chaos, the True Unmaking
bosses.intro_line: It is not evil; evil is a structure, and it predates structure. It does not, on the whole, miss you.
bosses.defeat_line: No defense saves you; only the clock kills it.

phase_flavor.opening: priority: Unmake the Order to strip player wards turn 1 (so nothing is mitigated later), then idle-threat.
phase_flavor.pressure: priority: Riot Fang / Overload on the squishiest target each round; it picks the squad apart one glass creature at a time.
phase_flavor.desperation: priority: The Gap Before Everything on the densest cluster — unsurvivable-by-defense AoE; forces the player to have already won the tempo war.
phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock + signature every turn. At ramped entropy the void deletes whole rows; the player either had the order-lock / lethal alpha ready or they didn't. Pure all-in.

bosses.name: Eros, the True Life
bosses.intro_line: To be near it is to find yourself, alarmingly, recovering.

phase_flavor.opening: priority: Bloom + Everything That Ever Grew to establish a heal floor the player can't yet out-damage. Tanks early, does nothing else.
phase_flavor.pressure: priority: Verdant Gift to start hitting back (life-as-weapon), Reclaim any add that died. Begins out-scaling.
phase_flavor.desperation: priority: signature self-rez insurance + Bloom spam; if `revive_locked` is false, it heals toward full and the fight resets. The Thanatos check happens here: lock it or lose the race.
phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock Verdant-Gift offense — having lost the heal-lock it goes for a desperate life-flood kill, racing to out-damage the player before its own ramped vitality runs the clock out. Only reachable after the revive is suppressed.

bosses.name: Thanatos, the True Ending
bosses.intro_line: The word is final, and it has never once been wrong.
bosses.defeat_line: Your dead do not come back; its drain ignores armor.

phase_flavor.opening: priority: Wither the squad's offense, then Soul Leech to bank HP. Sets up the subtraction; quiet and total.
phase_flavor.pressure: priority: Mark the Ledger on the enemy with the strongest revive/heal kit (lock the answer), then Soul Leech. Targets your recovery on purpose.
phase_flavor.desperation: priority: The Last Subtraction across the line every time it's up; with the ledger marked, each faint is final. Grinds the squad to nothing.
phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock + signature every turn; ramped entropy makes the absolute drain a true line-wipe. The player needs the Eros-burst kill loaded and enough bodies left to land it.

bosses.name: The Lawgiver
bosses.intro_line: He is back to enforce rules nobody can find the text of.
bosses.defeat_line: The verdict is read in order.

phase_flavor.opening: priority: Bulwark + Boulder Smash; establishes it as an immovable judge.
phase_flavor.pressure: priority: Edict of Standing Stone on the highest-threat enemy, telegraphed; stagger-locks the carry.
phase_flavor.desperation: priority: chains Gale Slash.
phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock; Edict every turn at ramped entropy — each verdict now one-shots through the stagger. The final ruling.

bosses.name: The Architect
bosses.intro_line: It keeps the stars in their assigned seats and treats your disorder as a personal filing error.

phase_flavor.opening: priority: Tailwind then Close the Firmament; establishes the queue-lock.
phase_flavor.pressure: priority: Bind the enemy's Chaos/burst carrier (pre-empt the counter), refresh the dome with Aegis.
phase_flavor.desperation: priority: signature on cooldown + Bind chains, stalling for entropy while the player is sequence-locked.
phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock under the dome; its capped-output ramps while yours is frozen. Break the firmament or lose to the schedule.

bosses.name: The Iron Throne
bosses.intro_line: The reliquary has been empty for ages. It guards it perfectly.
bosses.defeat_line: It will not let your damage land, and it retires your wounded.

phase_flavor.opening: priority: Enshrined Mercy + Aegis; builds an un-chippable wall.
phase_flavor.pressure: priority: Bind the burst carrier, mend behind the shrine; out-lasting begins.
phase_flavor.desperation: priority: Decommission any wounded enemy (revive-lock it), shrine-refresh; converts your losses into permanent ones.
phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock the ward + Decommission spam; it grinds the squad down under glass while the clock runs. Crack it with Chaos or be filed.

bosses.name: The Warden
bosses.intro_line: You will spend the whole fight chipping at a wall that is healing faster than you are scared, and behind its sigils it is humming.

phase_flavor.desperation: priority: Aegis + Bloom spam to deny burst windows; if you can't out-pace upkeep, the fight resets.
phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock the regrowth — it heals faster as it dies; the player needs the one-window kill loaded. It never strikes back; it simply refuses to end.

bosses.name: The Broker
bosses.intro_line: Everything you do is filed. It is not cruel — it is thorough, which is so much worse.
bosses.defeat_line: It silences your kit one skill at a time.

bosses.name: The Plaguelord
bosses.intro_line: It will heal you, it will harm you, and it cannot tell the difference anymore. The brass plate still reads FOR YOUR COMFORT.

phase_flavor.opening: priority: Final Absolution on the squad's anchor, then Soul Leech; sets the rot.

phase_flavor.apotheosis: priority: Overclock the drain; at ramped entropy Mercy Protocol reaps the whole front line and heals it back to a wall. Out-heal and out-burst, or be comforted to death.

bosses.name: The Free Wild

bosses.name: The Reveler

bosses.name: The Devourer

bosses.name: Demarei, the Harvest-Mother

bosses.name: Bakchanyr, the Revel-Lord
